notes: Most 2026 positions come from the Santa Monica Democratic Club 2026 candidate questionnaires (PDFs linked from Santa Monica Next). The club made no council endorsement. Phil Brock did not answer the questionnaire; his items come from his city candidate statement, campaign site and The Lookout. No findable policy positions for Derrick Townsend: he filed no city candidate statement, and his campaign site (dt4sm.com) only says he would 'restore safety' and break 'ineffective bureaucracy'. None for Lindsay Davis either: her candidate statement is about community healing and biodiversity, with no policy stances. Negative 'vote no' campaigns (UNITE HERE vs Negrete/Brock) are omitted as opponent characterizations. Searches used: 6
